_comment: Calibrated from data/samples_small (C3897/C3902). Road polygons cover the carriageway only. Deliberately excluded, because including them produced false positives: the park and its footpath (right, above y=0.38), the bus-stop pavement where people queue (top centre), and the corner plaza at the bottom left where pedestrians stand and wait. crosswalks are the marked zebra crossings; the signal box was located by cropping and inspecting the frame.
